blocks.x: Ports and carriers orchestrate billion-dollar physics: berth planning, crane productivity, vessel scheduling and cargo integrity. Telemetry-to-decision loops (berth windows, yard flows, maintenance) decide throughput on the same infrastructure, pure intelligence arbitrage. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in berth/vessel planning, yard/gate orchestration, crane/equipment maintenance, with cargo integrity close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
the queues and waits that come up first, Maritime, Ports & Shipping edition:

items: Vessel schedules vs. yard reality disconnected; anchorage waits cost.
Maersk-class ransomware memory; OT/corporate segmentation thin.
Truck appointments and yard moves on radio; congestion.
Paper bills of lading persist; fraud and delay.
